SELECT (SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'OLE_DB_Source_SchemaName' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'EPSDT_OH_BD_MEMBER_DATA' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'Data_Flow_Task706_') AS OLE_DB_Source_SchemaName,
(SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'OLE_DB_Source_TableName' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'EPSDT_OH_BD_MEMBER_DATA' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'Data_Flow_Task706_') AS OLE_DB_Source_TableName,
(SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'Flat_File_Destination_ContainerName' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'EPSDT_OH_BD_MEMBER_DATA' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'Data_Flow_Task706_') AS Flat_File_Destination_ContainerName,
(SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'Flat_File_Destination_FileName' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'EPSDT_OH_BD_MEMBER_DATA' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'Data_Flow_Task706_') AS Flat_File_Destination_FileName,
(SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'Flat_File_Destination_FilePath' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'EPSDT_OH_BD_MEMBER_DATA' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'Data_Flow_Task706_') AS Flat_File_Destination_FilePath,
(SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'Flat_File_Destination_Data_Flow_Task706__source_SchemaName' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'EPSDT_OH_BD_MEMBER_DATA' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'Flat_File_Destination_Data_Flow_Task706_') AS Flat_File_Destination_Data_Flow_Task706__source_SchemaName,
(SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'Flat_File_Destination_Data_Flow_Task706__source_TableName' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'EPSDT_OH_BD_MEMBER_DATA' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'Flat_File_Destination_Data_Flow_Task706_') AS Flat_File_Destination_Data_Flow_Task706__source_TableName,
(SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'Flat_File_Destination_Data_Flow_Task706__sink_SchemaName' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'EPSDT_OH_BD_MEMBER_DATA' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'Flat_File_Destination_Data_Flow_Task706_') AS Flat_File_Destination_Data_Flow_Task706__sink_SchemaName,
(SELECT PARAMETER_VALUE FROM AZ_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAMETER_NAME = 'Flat_File_Destination_Data_Flow_Task706__sink_TableName' AND PIPELINE_NAME = 'EPSDT_OH_BD_MEMBER_DATA' AND DATAFLOW_NAME = 'Flat_File_Destination_Data_Flow_Task706_') AS Flat_File_Destination_Data_Flow_Task706__sink_TableName;
